status: Closed — Fixed in current refactor-aware claim admission
area: Claim admission and physical line budget
finding: Claim admission blocks a correction task before it can split an already oversized declared module. TASK-GIT-0025 was refused because `active-work-summary.ts` is 601 lines, one line above the 600 hard limit, even though the card is the governed correction path for that surface.

evidenceOrRepro: Original reproduction was `ATM_TOUCHED_PHYSICAL_LINE_BUDGET_BLOCKED` on 2026-07-29 when `active-work-summary.ts` measured 601 lines. Current source measures 455 lines; `packages/cli/src/commands/next/oversized-extraction-admission.ts` now admits only explicitly declared extraction tasks at claim stage, while preserving pre-close and commit line-budget enforcement. Regression coverage is present in `tests/cli/oversized-extraction-claim-pathway.test.ts`.
followUp: Keep the claim-only boundary and regression coverage. The current repository-wide budget report has a separate 608-line `push-command.ts` violation; it is not this card and requires separate triage.
